## Core Specialties
- **Custom Sublimation Jersey Design**: Basketball jerseys, baseball uniforms, soccer and football kits, polo shirts, and esports jerseys.
- **Realistic 3D Garment Mockups**: Professional product presentation previews for athletes, teams, and marketing.
- **Factory Print-Ready Vector Preparation**: 1:1 scale templates in Adobe Illustrator (.AI), EPS, and CMYK print-ready PDF formats ready for direct dye-sublimation garment printing.
- **Team Roster Typography**: Full roster production layouts with individual player names and numbers across sizes from Youth to Adult 3XL+.
- **Athletic Branding**: Team logos, crests, emblems, and typographic identity packages.

## Design Catalog Categories
- **Basketball Jerseys**: 11+ colorways including Black, White, Blue, Red, Green, Yellow, Orange, Purple, Pink, Cyan, Gray, and Beige.
- **Baseball Jerseys**: Full-button and two-button custom baseball uniforms.
- **Polo Shirts**: Sublimated polo shirts for sports teams, corporate staff, and events.
- **T-Shirts**: Graphic tees across corporate, sports, and special event themes.
- **Hoodies**: Custom athletic hoodies and outerwear.
- **Football & Soccer**: Athletic kits and jerseys.
- **Brand Logos**: Team crests, athletic badges, and mascot vector artwork.

## Pricing & Commercial Licensing
- **Single Pre-Made Design**: From $49 USD. Non-exclusive commercial license, source vector files (AI/EPS), high-resolution print files, instant delivery.
- **Custom Commission**: 100% unique custom sportswear design built from scratch, 3D mockup presentation, factory sublimation-ready vectors, up to 3 revisions.
- **Bulk Team Package**: Discounted team rates (10+ units), full roster name and number layouts, primary and secondary logo packages.
